# Sentou-Ken Martial Arts Academy

> Sentou-Ken is a multi-discipline martial arts academy in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, founded in 2001 by Sensei P.M.G. (7th Dan Black Belt, Shito-Ryu Karate). It teaches Karate, Judo, Jujutsu, Kenjutsu, Kalaripayattu, Varmam, Silambam, Simmakalari and Adimurai, plus a dedicated Women's Self-Defence program, to students aged 6 and up across 3 branches in Chennai.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2001 (25+ years of experience as of 2026)
- Founder / Chief Instructor: Sensei P.M.G. — 7th Dan Black Belt (Karate, Shito-Ryu), 3rd Dan Black Belt (WSKF), Black Belt in Judo (Judo Federation of India), 5th Dan in Jujutsu, 1st Dan in Kenjutsu
- Disciplines taught: Karate, Judo, Jujutsu, Kenjutsu, Kalaripayattu, Varmam, Silambam, Simmakalari, Adimurai, Women's Self-Defence
- Programs: Kids Martial Arts, Teenage Training, Adult Martial Arts, Women's Self Defence (minimum age 6)
- Students trained: 25,000+ across the founder's career
- Branches: 3, all in Chennai
- Google rating: 4.8 out of 5 (31 reviews)
- Address: 10 Gandhi Street, Sudharsan Nagar, Madambakkam Main Rd, Madambakkam, Chennai – 600073 (near Jayam Supermarket)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98405 40985
- Email: sentouken.admin@gmail.com
